subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in `memory_search` when visibility permits, while keeping broader private cross-conversation recall behind the default-off owner/admin setting?
rationale: The remaining behavior is both a real session recall gap and a transcript privacy boundary, and the repository already has a targeted fix candidate plus a broader product PR that must not conflict.

options.title: Land targeted fix first
options.body: Accept a visibility-preserving live-orphan fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261, then keep broader private recall as a separate default-off product setting.

options.title: Fold into broader recall
options.body: Pause the narrow bug fix and resolve the behavior only through the new remember-across-private-conversations product surface.

options.title: Keep fail-closed
options.body: Reject live orphan recall unless a session-store entry exists, preserving the strict current boundary but leaving the reported gateway recall gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land targeted fix first
recommendation.body: Accept a visibility-preserving live-orphan fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261, then keep broader private recall as a separate default-off product setting.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active broader private-recall direction that needs to align with any targeted session-memory visibility fix.
